data.one_liner: Open local files with the platform's native viewer/app from Flutter.
data.what_it_does: The plugin launches the OS's default app to display a given file path. It works on Android, iOS, desktop, and web and returns a result indicating success or error.
use_when: You need to let the user view or share a file using the device's native apps
You want a simple cross‑platform way to open PDFs, images, videos, etc.
avoid_when: You need to embed the file content inside your UI
You require fine‑grained control over the viewer or custom rendering
strengths: Supports MIME type and UTI overrides
weaknesses: Only opens files; no preview or editing capabilities
Requires native configuration (Android manifest, iOS FileProvider)
data.setup_notes: Add FileProvider to AndroidManifest and filepaths.xml; iOS may need UTIs; optional Linux FFI or Process fallback; no build_runner needed

alternatives.name: file
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides file system utilities without native opening, useful if you only need file manipulation
